name: CAT vs DE Pair Trade Analysis
description: Research study comparing Caterpillar (CAT) vs Deere (DE) as a long/short pair trade. Analyzes cumulative return paths, rolling return spread, daily return correlation, and key pair statistics over the last 2 years.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CAT vs DE PAIR TRADE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Compares Caterpillar (CAT) vs Deere (DE) as a long/short pair trade.
#
# Chart 1 (cs_lines): Cumulative return paths for both assets overlaid
# Chart 2 (xy_lines): Rolling 126-day return spread (CAT minus DE) — pair P&L proxy
# Chart 3 (xy_scatter): Daily returns CAT vs DE with regression line
# Table (cs_summary_table): Key per-asset stats + pair statistics
# =============================================================================

# --- Per-Asset Data (for cs_lines overlay) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(daily_ret)
bar_ts = index()

# --- Reference Data for Pair Analysis ---
cat_o, cat_h, cat_l, cat_c, cat_v, cat_vw, cat_n = reference_stocks(ticker="CAT")()
de_o, de_h, de_l, de_c, de_v, de_vw, de_n = reference_stocks(ticker="DE")()
cat_close = ffill(cat_c)
de_close = ffill(de_c)

# Daily returns from reference data
cat_ret = (cat_close - (cat_close >> 1)) / (cat_close >> 1)
de_ret = (de_close - (de_close >> 1)) / (de_close >> 1)

# Rolling 126-day (6-month) returns for spread
cat_6m = (cat_close - (cat_close >> 126)) / (cat_close >> 126)
de_6m = (de_close - (de_close >> 126)) / (de_close >> 126)
spread = cat_6m - de_6m

# --- Pair Statistics ---
# Rolling 252-day correlation
corr_val = rolling_corr(window=252)(cat_ret, de_ret)

# Beta: DE returns regressed on CAT returns
beta_val = beta(window=252)(de_ret, cat_ret)

# Per-asset annualized volatility (252-day)
cat_vol = stddev(period=252)(cat_ret) * sqrt(252)
de_vol = stddev(period=252)(de_ret) * sqrt(252)

# Cumulative total returns from reference data
cat_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(cat_ret)
de_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(de_ret)

# Annualized return proxy (cumulative / years approximation via simple last value)
# Using cumulative mean * 252 as annualized return estimate
cat_ann_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(cat_ret) * 252
de_ann_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(de_ret) * 252

# Sharpe approximation: annualized return / annualized vol
cat_sharpe = cat_ann_ret / cat_vol
de_sharpe = de_ann_ret / de_vol

# =========================================================================
# CHART 1: Cumulative Return Paths (cs_lines — one line per asset)
# =========================================================================
cs_lines(
    title='Cumulative Return Path: CAT vs DE',
    category='1. Return Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, cum_ret)

# =========================================================================
# CHART 2: Rolling Return Spread (xy_lines — pair P&L proxy)
# =========================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 6M Return Spread (CAT minus DE)',
    category='2. Pair Spread',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='6M Rolling Return Spread',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CAT - DE Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, spread)

# =========================================================================
# CHART 3: Daily Return Scatter (xy_scatter — correlation visualization)
# =========================================================================
xy_scatter(
    title='Daily Returns: CAT vs DE',
    category='3. Correlation',
    x_axis_label='CAT Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='DE Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Returns', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0%')
    ]),
    order=1
)(cat_ret, de_ret)

# =========================================================================
# TABLE: Key Statistics — per-asset + pair (cs_summary_table)
# =========================================================================
cs_summary_table(
    title='Key Statistics: CAT vs DE Pair',
    category='4. Statistics',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Key Statistics',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Volatility', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Sharpe Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Beta (DE vs CAT)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Spread', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=1
)(cum_ret, cat_ann_ret, cat_vol, cat_sharpe, corr_val, beta_val, spread)
